en: A black-and-white vintage postcard showing a quiet street in a small town. On the right side, there are two-story residential buildings with shuttered windows. Several people, including women and children, are standing or walking along the street. The left side of the image features trees and greenery. The style of clothing and architecture suggests an early 20th-century European rural scene. The top of the card has printed text indicating the location and subject.
